spec: 1
id: fo2tweaks
name: FO2tweaks
game: fallout2
needs.sfall: 4.1.3
settings:
  main.worldmap_key:
    kind: text
    default: W
    label: Worldmap key
    help: Hotkey to open the worldmap. Set to 0 to disable.
  main.townmap_key:
    kind: text
    default: "Y"
    label: Town map key
    help: Hotkey to open the town map. Set to 0 or T to keep the default T key.
  main.no_scope_penalty:
    kind: bool
    default: 1
    label: No scope penalty
    help: "Don't penalize scoped weapons chance to hit at close range."
  main.improved_grenades:
    kind: bool
    default: 1
    label: Improved grenades
    help: "Ignore target AC when attacking with a grenade, and allow tossing grenades into empty hexes."
  main.molotov_fire:
    kind: bool
    default: 1
    label: Molotov fire damage
    help: Molotov does fire damage.
  main.max_knockback:
    kind: int
    min: -1
    sentinels:
      "-1": Vanilla (unlimited)
      "0": No knockback
    default: -1
    label: Max knockback
    help: Limit max knockback distance in hexes.
  main.trunk_space:
    kind: bool
    default: 0
    label: Bottomless trunk
    help: Enable bottomless car trunk.
  main.autodoors:
    kind: choice
    options:
      - value: 0
        label: "Off"
      - value: 1
        label: Open
      - value: 2
        label: Open and close
    default: 1
    label: Automatic doors
    help: Automatically open and walk through unlocked doors when not in combat.
  main.carry_weight:
    kind: bool
    default: 0
    label: Unlimited carry weight
    help: Virtually unlimited carry weight.
  main.level5:
    kind: bool
    default: 0
    label: Level 5 after the temple
    help: Level 5 after completing the Temple of Trials.
  main.ammobox:
    kind: bool
    default: 1
    label: Ammo box
    help: Display current ammo type in an infobox during combat.
  main.modoc_brahmin:
    kind: bool
    default: 1
    label: Protect Modoc brahmin
    help: "Modoc brahmin are on the player's team, to avoid party members killing them all accidentally."
  main.healing_revision:
    kind: bool
    default: 1
    label: Healing revision
    help: Alternative healing implementation.
  main.item_charges:
    kind: bool
    default: 1
    label: Item charges
    help: Medical kits (with healing revision) and the Super Tool Kit (on sfall) have a fixed number of charges. Drop an item on the same kind of item in a hand to combine them.
  main.hp_over_head:
    kind: bool
    default: 0
    label: HP over head
    help: "Display current HP over head for the player, party and nearby enemies in combat. Has some delay."
  main.damage_mod:
    kind: bool
    default: 1
    label: AP/JHP damage mod
    help: "AP/JHP damage mod. Needs sfall's DamageFormula at 0 to work correctly."
    gated-by:
      id: sfall.Misc.DamageFormula
      is:
        - 0
  main.highlighting:
    kind: bool
    default: 1
    label: Expanded highlighting
    help: "Expanded highlighting mod. Disable sfall's default highlighting if you use this."
  main.auto_reload:
    kind: bool
    default: 1
    label: Auto reload
    help: Automatically reload both weapons at the end of combat.
  main.party_level_match:
    kind: bool
    default: 0
    label: Party level match
    help: Party NPC level will match player level more closely. Includes all vanilla and RP companions.
  main.unlimited_party:
    kind: bool
    default: 0
    label: Unlimited party
    help: "Don't check the charisma limit when joining the party. All other checks are intact."
  main.keymap:
    kind: bool
    default: 1
    label: Key remapping
    help: Remap keys according to the table in the keymap section of the ini.
  main.min_light_level:
    kind: int
    min: 0
    max: 100
    sentinels:
      "0": "Off"
    default: 0
    label: Minimum light level
    help: Map light level will never go below this percentage. Recommended value is 49.
  main.speedup:
    kind: bool
    default: 0
    label: Game speedup
    help: Overall game speedup. Check the readme before enabling.
  main.run_speed:
    kind: bool
    default: 0
    label: Run speed increase
    help: "Increase run speed for the player and/or party members. Needs sfall's UseFileSystemOverride at 1."
  main.no_drop_items_on_death:
    kind: bool
    default: 1
    label: Keep inventory on gib
    help: "Critters getting melted, exploded or burned to ashes won't drop their inventory, allowing normal looting."
  main.gigolo_limit:
    kind: int
    min: 0
    sentinels:
      "0": Vanilla
    default: 0
    label: Gigolo limit
    help: How many sexual encounters with different people it takes to be considered a Gigolo.
  main.auto_cursor:
    kind: bool
    default: 0
    label: Auto cursor
    help: Automatic cursor change on mouseover in combat.
  main.ap_rollover:
    kind: int
    min: 0
    default: 2
    label: AP rollover
    help: Roll over this many unused action points to the next turn. Replaces the AC bonus.
  no_scope_penalty.remove:
    kind: text
    default: "287"
    label: Remove scope perk from
    help: "Weapon pids whose scope range perk is removed, with range increased to 150%. Default is the scoped hunting rifle."
    gated-by:
      id: fo2tweaks.main.no_scope_penalty
      is:
        - 1
  no_scope_penalty.to_long:
    kind: text
    default: "143,350"
    label: Scope perk becomes long range
    help: Weapon pids whose scope range perk is replaced with long range. No effect in vanilla or RP; changes EcCo versions.

      id: fo2tweaks.main.no_scope_penalty
      is:
        - 1
  improved_grenades.weapons:

    label: Affected weapons
    help: Weapon pids the grenade improvements apply to.

---
spec: 1
id: rpu23
name: Restoration Project Updated 2.3
game: fallout2
type: base
becomes: fallout2rpu
installer.windows.built-with: inno
installer.other.run: rpu-install.sh
settings:
  main.marcus_armor:
    file: mods/rpu.ini
    kind: bool
    default: 1
    label: Mutant armor for Marcus
  main.dogmeat_armor:
    file: mods/rpu.ini
    kind: bool
    default: 1
    label: Kevlar armor for Dogmeat
  main.smoking:
    file: mods/rpu.ini
    kind: bool
    default: 1
    label: Smoking animation
    help: "The player character's smoking animation."
  main.lenny_new_look:
    file: mods/rpu.ini
    kind: bool
    default: 1
    label: New look for Lenny
    help: Gives Lenny a different ghoul sprite.
  main.vault_boxer:
    file: mods/rpu.ini
    kind: bool
    default: 1
    label: Vault boxer in the ring
    help: Use the unique vault boxer model when fighting in the ring.
  main.goris_derobing_speed:
    file: mods/upu.ini
    kind: int
    min: 16
    max: 100
    unit: fps
    sentinels:
      0: "Off"
    default: 50
    label: Goris de-robing speed
    help: How fast Goris takes off his robe. The original game plays it at 16. No effect if the alternative low FPS Goris de-robing is installed.
  main.critters_walk_faster:
    file: mods/upu.ini
    kind: bool
    default: 1
    label: Faster walking for slow critters
    help: "Robots, various guards and a few other critters walk much slower than everyone else; this speeds them up a little. Cosmetic only. No effect if the alternative low FPS walk speed fix is installed."
  main.wipe_inventory:
    file: mods/upu.ini
    kind: bool
    default: 0
    label: Fresh merchant stock on each restock
    help: "Off, merchants keep every item you ever sold them, on top of their restocks. On, each restock gives them fresh inventory. Quest items are always kept. Can be changed mid-game."
  ncr.repeatable_brahmin_drive:
    file: mods/upu.ini
    kind: bool
    default: 1
    label: Repeatable NCR brahmin drive
    help: "The NCR to Redding brahmin drive can be done again, as Duppo says. The drives end if Hal dies."
version: 2.3.34
archive: rpu_v2.3.34.zip
installer.windows.asset: rpu_v2.3.34.exe
installer.other.asset: rpu_v2.3.34.zip

---
spec: 1
id: upu
name: Unofficial Patch Updated
game: fallout2
type: base
becomes: fallout2upu
installer.windows.built-with: inno
installer.other.run: upu-install.sh
settings:
  main.goris_derobing_speed:
    file: mods/upu.ini
    kind: int
    min: 16
    max: 100
    unit: fps
    sentinels:
      0: "Off"
    default: 50
    label: Goris de-robing speed
    help: How fast Goris takes off his robe. The original game plays it at 16. No effect if the alternative low FPS Goris de-robing is installed.
  main.critters_walk_faster:
    file: mods/upu.ini
    kind: bool
    default: 1
    label: Faster walking for slow critters
    help: "Robots, various guards and a few other critters walk much slower than everyone else; this speeds them up a little. Cosmetic only. No effect if the alternative low FPS walk speed fix is installed."
  main.wipe_inventory:
    file: mods/upu.ini
    kind: bool
    default: 0
    label: Fresh merchant stock on each restock
    help: "Off, merchants keep every item you ever sold them, on top of their restocks. On, each restock gives them fresh inventory. Quest items are always kept. Can be changed mid-game."
  ncr.repeatable_brahmin_drive:
    file: mods/upu.ini
    kind: bool
    default: 1
    label: Repeatable NCR brahmin drive
    help: "The NCR to Redding brahmin drive can be done again, as Duppo says. The drives end if Hal dies."
version: "34"
archive: upu_v34.zip
